title: Gumball To Flow
description: Add gumball to procedural 3D preview. When moving/rotating/scaling, insert correct transform nodes in the flow graph (translate with sliders/vector, rotate, scale), rewire automatically, make incremental space, re-grab updates existing nodes, configurable transform detail granularity.
summary: Gumball drag is now live: onDragStart inserts transform chain and selects all new flow nodes; onDrag (rAF-throttled) updates slider/params and re-evaluates for live 3D preview; proxy pose resets each frame so geometry comes from graph eval only. gumballActiveWidgetIds highlights transform + source in 3D; flow canvas multi-selects transform/slider/vector nodes during drag. WorldCanvas uses frameloop always while dragging.
